fields.Name: T214 - Foreign Key Link Navigation
fields.Description: Navigates from a record to a related record via a foreign-key field's open-link affordance, verifying cross-record FK navigation.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the 'Event Registrations' entity grid — type 'Event Registrations' in the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box and click it (or navigate to http://localhost:4200/app/data-explorer/Data?entity=Event%20Registrations). Click a row, then 'Open Full Record'. The form has foreign-key fields (e.g. Member, Event). Next to a foreign-key field's value is a small OPEN/NAVIGATE icon (an up-right arrow / external-link icon). Click that icon on one FK field (e.g. Member) to open the RELATED record. Verify a DIFFERENT record's form opens (the URL changes to a different entity/record, e.g. a Member record). Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Started on an Event Registration record and used a foreign-key field's open/navigate icon
A DIFFERENT related record opened (URL changed to another entity/record, e.g. a Member)
No error messages or crash pages
